purpose: Establish a durable console log region inside the 2 GiB managed span, replacing the unreachable Android ramoops PA 0xac340000

problem.old_pa_relative_to_span: 32.3 GiB BELOW physBase, outside the span; ml_io_map cannot describe it, so no byte was ever written and every pstore read was empty
problem.second_cause: tb710fu_ramoops_init() is called after arm_vm_init() returns; the current stop is inside arm_vm_init (stage 47), so init never ran in that boot either

region.alignment: 16 KiB (also 2 MiB-aligned at the macro level; geometry check confirms 16 KiB)
region.avoids: window top page 0x93ffff000 reserved by 0007 for identity-mapped switch markers
region.device_iomem: 8c0000000-9fdccefff : System RAM (user-supplied /proc/iomem), so the address is real DRAM

design_decisions.chosen: change the default PA in osfmk/kern/tb710fu_ramoops.c (patch 0008)
design_decisions.rejected: new ADT property read via SecureDTLookupEntry/GetProperty - more invasive, would need generator changes and conflict with the no-official-script-edits rule
design_decisions.override_rule: ramoops=<PA> is honoured only when the value is inside the span with room for the zone; the live 0xac340000 argument is therefore rejected and the in-window default used
design_decisions.zone_default: now enabled by default (previously disabled unless ramoops= was supplied)
design_decisions.excluded_table: NOT introduced. devicetree.py emits an all-zero table that DarwinBoot overwrites from the UEFI memory map, so a preset (base,size) cannot survive without a firmware-side reservation. Correctness instead rests on the region being far above topOfKernelData + 32 MiB head reserve, plus ml_io_map -> io_map -> pmap_map being an independent device mapping that does not need the physical aperture or the free list.
design_decisions.file_scope: 0008 only touches ramoops.c; 0005/0006/0007 touch arm_vm_init.c, so the sets are disjoint

verification.patch_chain: 0005->0006->0007->0008 applies in order on the tree carrying 0001-0004: PASS (verify_0008_chain.py)
verification.region_geometry: 7/7 PASS (verify_0008_region.py): in span, 16 KiB aligned, above kernel image, above head reserve, avoids 0007 marker, clamp accepts, no reserve panic

how_to_use.read_log: from Android/TWRP: dd if=/dev/mem bs=4096 skip=$((0x93ff00000/4096)) count=64 | od -An -tx1 -N48
how_to_use.note: the head is the Linux-compatible persistent_ram header {sig=0x43474244, start, size}; if CONFIG_STRICT_DEVMEM blocks /dev/mem, read it in TWRP
how_to_use.switch_markers: the same image still carries 0007's identity-mapped markers at 0x93ffff000, so it can also localise the TTBR1 stop

boundary: Diagnostic/support image, not a functional fix and not hardware acceptance.
ramoops_init runs after arm_vm_init returns, so this region stays empty in the current stage-47 stop; 0007's identity-mapped markers cover that stage.
The region is not protected by an ADT excluded entry (DarwinBoot would overwrite it); a firmware-side reservation would be needed for a hard guarantee.
No device flash, reboot or partition operation was performed by the agent.
